candidate_merges.message: Stop idle extension polling (#21890) ## Description Stop status and resource watchers when neither the Aspire panel nor an AppHost editor is visible and no extension-owned run/debug session or explicit consumer needs data. Background tabs and passive debugger hints no longer keep polling alive. Preserve the configured active cadence and immediate resumption, and move the existing lifecycle coverage and brief documentation with the change.
